desc: Title box at the top, no lower captions. The tiny boy holds his red autograph book up to the towering boss in black tie; the boss leans in and reaches for it.
Dennis takes the book and writes in it; the boy watches on tiptoe.
Insert: the page. 'Phone me in 9 years' appears word by word as it's spoken, then a made-up signature. No captions.
Home, night: the dad at the kitchen table with the bills and a nearly empty coin jar; the boy in the doorway.
The shed: a battered fifth-hand kart (dents, rust, tape, odd panels, layers of old stickers). Lifted from v1, still moody.
The dad sands and paints it; then it shines like new. The red book is pinned on the wall.
Split screen: the dad's jobs. Office desk (9:00), outdoors in hi-vis (18:00), the kart in the shed (23:00).
The kart track paddock: kids by their karts. He's the only Black kid.
A group of kids and parents with their backs to him. He stands alone, helmet in hand.
Behind a van he wipes his eye; then, as his dad comes, he straightens up.
His dad kneels to his level, a hand on his shoulder; on 'track' he points at the circuit. The boy nods.
Visor down, the kart launches and passes the others into the first corner.
'Again': the chequered flag over his kart.
'And again': he lifts a trophy on the top step.
'And again': a shelf crowded with trophies, the red book among them.
"(age 13)" under the caption. In the boss's office he signs the contract, his dad behind him; then a handshake.
"(age 23)" under the caption. Brazil 2008, last lap in the rain: his silver car closes on a slower white car. Fuller Interlagos: stands both sides, boards, light poles, towers, footbridge, city.
Two corners from the end: up the inside, side by side, and through.
Across the line under the chequered flag; his crew in the garage erupt.
Dennis on the pit wall: a slow breath, then a clenched fist.
Callback: the fixed-up kart under the bulb, the book on the wall.
The grown driver lifts his helmet off and swings it down to his side; face clear on 'Lewis'. Hard cut.
